evidence: deepseek-v4-flash: "for c in range(3)" and rejects any neighbor with "color[nb] == c"
gpt-oss-120b: recursively tries colors "(1, 2, 3)" and checks previously colored neighbors
affordance_in_statement: Agency 1 operates with W1 = (2, 2, 2), Agency 2 operates with W2 = (-2, 2, -2), and Agency 3 operates with W3 = (2, -2, -2); the interaction value is the standard dot product; the total must equal exactly -4m.
removal_suggestion: Use agency vectors whose pairwise unequal dot products are not all identical, while retaining the same exact-sum requirement. This preserves the assignment-and-sum task but makes valid assignments potentially include compensating equal-agency edges instead of exactly proper 3-colorings.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Treats compliance as ordinary 3-colorability and performs sequential backtracking, rejecting every monochromatic edge.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The supplied vectors make every unequal-agency dot product -4 and every equal-agency dot product 12, so a total of -4m is equivalent to having no monochromatic edge.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Uses the same ordinary 3-coloring reduction with recursive fixed-order search.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The supplied vectors and target -4m turn the weighted dot-product condition into the requirement that adjacent departments receive different agencies.

common_affordance: The vector values make every pair of distinct agencies contribute exactly -4, so the exact-sum condition is equivalent to proper 3-coloring.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Enumerates assignments with exhaustive product-style search, which is exponential in n and does not scale to n = 40.
Also reduces the condition to 3-coloring and uses exponential-style coloring search, so it is vulnerable to hard 3-colorability instances at the stated bound.

recommended_edit: Change W3 from (2, -2, -2) to (2, -2, 0). Then W1·W2 = -4, W1·W3 = 0, and W2·W3 = -8, so unequal agencies no longer have a uniform contribution. The displayed first example remains valid with its shown assignment and target, and the second example remains infeasible, while both survivor programs can reject valid non-proper assignments.
